Engineering a Sustainable Future: Empowering Green and Digital Solutions – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
Engineering a Sustainable Future: Empowering Green and Digital Solutions
Are you excited to combine your engineering studies with the chance to experience Norway’s breathtaking nature and sustainable work-life balance?
The Institute of Engineering invites you to join our courses and explore Norway’s innovative and green approach to engineering.
Our institute is a regional leader in advanced research and education, offering study programs in Electrical and Electronics, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering. These disciplines prepare students to explore technological advancements and develop sustainable solutions. With a strong commitment to excellence in education and research, we strive to shape the future of industry and society.
The bachelor program in Institute of Engineering at Østfold University College in Norway, is launching a new programme for international students:

All courses are taught at our campus in
Fredrikstad
.
The programme is an international alternative integrated into the ordinary curriculum, so you will meet and work with Norwegian students and companies during your stay. Students may take the courses as a full-year study, single semester or as individual courses.
